caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical cup with a slightly flared rim and a subtle base, centered against a plain, beige background. The cup appears metallic, rendered in shades of gray that suggest a smooth and reflective surface with soft highlights and shadows indicating curvature and depth. The paper on which the cup is drawn is rectangular and has slightly darker borders, suggesting it might be affixed or matted onto a larger, uniformly beige sheet. There are faint tape marks visible in each corner of the drawing paper, further indicating it has been mounted. No other objects, textures, or colors are present within the composition.
